description: Watch a list of company domains and get back only what changed on their job boards since the last run with the same watch name: new, closed, and reposted postings, read live from 17 job boards including Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, and Workday. Each change row carries the full job description, a stable posting key, and the board it came from; each company also gets a summary row with open postings and 30 day hiring velocity. The first run for a watch sets the baseline, and its rows are marked is_backfill and never charged. Optional signed webhook delivery. A run that does not succeed is returned as an error with its run ID. Read-only on the boards; requires an APIFY_TOKEN and consumes Apify credits per change returned.

board_hints.description: Point a domain at its job board when the watch cannot find it, as domain=provider:slug, for example acme.com=greenhouse:acmeinc or acme.com=workday:acme.wd5/External. Providers: greenhouse, lever, ashby, workable, smartrecruiters, personio, recruitee, workday, rippling.

closed_after_misses.description: A posting closes after this many complete board reads without it. A partial read never counts. 1 to 5. Default 2.

custom_keywords.description: Extra title keywords, matched on whole words. Prefix with T1: for the strongest tier or T3: for the weakest; no prefix is tier 2. Adding any keyword also adds the Custom category.

description_max_chars.description: Longest description kept per row. job_description_chars always reports the full length. 500 to 100000. Default 20000.

domains.description: Company website domains to watch, for example stripe.com. The watch reads each company's own job board. Up to 2,000 per run.

first_run_mode.description: What a domain's first run returns. recent returns postings the board dates inside the last N days, baseline_only returns the summary row, all_open returns every open posting. First run rows are marked is_backfill and never charged. Default recent.

first_run_recent_days.description: With first_run_mode recent: how many days back counts as recent. 1 to 30. Default 7.

include_job_description.description: Adds the full description text to new and reposted rows. Closed rows carry no description. Default true.

keyword_categories.description: Only changes to postings whose title matches these role categories are returned and charged. All returns every posting change. Every posting still counts toward hiring velocity. Default ["All"].

max_charge_usd.description: Optional. When the next change would take this run's charges over this amount, the remaining changes are held and delivered first on the next run.

max_domains.description: Domains past this number are skipped. 1 to 2000. Default 500.

repost_window_days.description: A closed posting that comes back inside this many days is reported as reposted, not new. 7 to 60. Default 30.

state_store.description: Optional key value store that holds the watch state. Leave empty to use the store account-hiring-watch-state in your own Apify account.

watch_name.description: Keeps separate watch lists apart. Use one name per list or client. Changing the name starts a new watch, and its first run sets the baseline. Default default.

webhook_batch_mode.description: batch sends up to 50 changes per request, grouped by company. per_change sends one request per change, for tools where one request is one row (Clay table webhooks, Zapier). Default batch.

webhook_secret.description: Required with webhook_url. Signs each request (HMAC SHA256). A whsec_ prefixed secret is base64 decoded per the Standard Webhooks spec.

webhook_url.description: Optional HTTPS endpoint. Changes are sent as signed Standard Webhooks requests, and a change is charged only after your endpoint answers 2xx.
